{{< video videos/numerical_properties.mp4 >}}

Ubiquitin's Cα B factors drive the colour of every representation through the
     `Color Attribute Map` node, with the loop radius thickening as the structure turns.

     ProteinMotion maps the same values onto per-residue cartoon thickness and reveals them
     with a staggered delay, and draws a colour legend. Thickness by field, the staggered
     reveal (`Animate Stagger`) and the legend annotation are not available yet.

After ProteinMotion's [`numerical_properties.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/numerical_properties.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/numerical_properties.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/numerical_properties.py"}
{{< include scripts/numerical_properties.py >}}
```
